name: kgdiff-monorepo
description: git diff for knowledge graphs: semantic, visual diff and review for graph data.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tests && tsc -p action
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.build:site: pnpm vite build --config apps/site/vite.config.ts && pnpm build:docs
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && biome format --write packages && tsx scripts/sync-citation.ts
scripts.release: pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm check:packages && changeset publish
